trailer_style.description: Style of attribution trailer to add to commits

generated_with.description: Add Generated with Sennit line to commit messages and issues and PRs

enabled.description: Summarize a session left idle with a large context

context_tokens.description: Context size (in prompt tokens) a session must exceed before an idle summarize is worth doing

after.description: How long a session must sit idle before it is summarized (Go duration)

max_depth.description: Maximum directory depth the @-mention completions popup walks when listing files; 0 is unlimited

max_items.description: Maximum number of files the @-mention completions popup lists; 0 is unlimited

model.description: The model configuration. Read only from the global config — a model block in a project config is ignored

providers.description: AI provider configurations. Read only from the global config — a providers block in a project config is ignored

hooks.description: User-defined shell commands that fire on hook events (e.g. PreToolUse)

env.description: Environment variables to set on startup

name.description: Friendly display name shown in the TUI for this hook

matcher.description: Regex pattern tested against the tool name. Empty means match all tools.

command.description: Shell command to execute when the hook fires

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the hook command

disabled.description: Whether this LSP server is disabled

command.description: Command to execute for the LSP server

args.description: Arguments to pass to the LSP server command

env.description: Environment variables to set to the LSP server command

filetypes.description: File types this LSP server handles

root_markers.description: Files or directories that indicate the project root

init_options.description: Initialization options passed to the LSP server during initialize request

options.description: LSP server-specific settings passed during initialization

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for LSP server initialization

command.description: Command to execute for stdio MCP servers

env.description: Environment variables to set for the MCP server

args.description: Arguments to pass to the MCP server command

url.description: URL for HTTP or SSE MCP servers

disabled.description: Whether this MCP server is disabled

disabled_tools.description: List of tools from this MCP server to disable

enabled_tools.description: Allow list of tools from this MCP server

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for MCP server connections

headers.description: HTTP headers for HTTP/SSE MCP servers

oauth.description: Enable OAuth 2.1 authorization flow for this MCP server (HTTP transport only)

oauth_client_id.description: Pre-registered OAuth client ID for servers without dynamic client registration

oauth_client_secret.description: Pre-registered OAuth client secret paired with oauth_client_id

oauth_callback_port.description: Fixed localhost port for the OAuth callback

context_paths.description: Paths to files containing context information for the AI. Sennit auto-loads only its own conventions (AGENTS.md/SENNIT.md and casing/local variants); list other tools' files here explicitly (e.g. CLAUDE.md) to have Sennit read them too

global_context_paths.description: Paths to files containing global context information for the AI

skills_paths.description: Paths to directories containing Agent Skills (folders with SKILL.md files)

debug_lsp.description: Enable debug logging for LSP servers

auto_summarize_at.description: Summarize once a session's context reaches this many tokens even when the model's own window is larger - 0 means no cap

auto_summarize_idle.description: Summarize a session that has grown past a context size and then sat idle

data_directory.description: Project-local directory for workspace-scoped state (lock file, config overrides, legacy pre-migration database) — not the shared session/message database. Relative paths are resolved against the working directory; absolute paths are used as-is.

disabled_tools.description: List of built-in tools to disable and hide from the agent

disable_default_providers.description: Ignore all default/embedded providers. When enabled, providers must be fully specified in the config file with base_url, models, and api_key - no merging with defaults occurs

initialize_as.description: Name of the context file to create/update during project initialization

auto_lsp.description: Automatically setup LSPs based on root markers

progress.description: Show indeterminate progress updates during long operations

notifications.description: Notification style to use. Options: auto (default), native, osc, bell, disabled. Auto selects based on environment: native for local sessions, osc for SSH (with automatic OSC 99/777 detection).

disabled_skills.description: List of skill names to disable and hide from the agent

web_search.description: Web search backend configuration. Defaults to the keyless DuckDuckGo scraper when omitted.

background_agents.description: Allow asynchronous subagent delegation and the task_* tools, letting the model delegate work to background tasks in this workspace. Turning this off only blocks new dispatch — a task already running keeps running to completion. Does not affect threads.

history_retention_days.description: Age in days after which "sennit gc" deletes sessions (and their messages/files) and finished threads. 0 keeps history forever. Not enforced automatically — run "sennit gc" (e.g. from cron) to apply it.

allowed_tools.description: List of tools that don't require permission prompts

bypass.description: DANGEROUS: skip every permission prompt from startup — the agent runs every tool without asking. Equivalent to always-on yolo mode.

base_url.description: Base URL for the provider's API

proxy_url.description: Proxy URL for requests to this provider (http/https/socks5); set to "none" to force a direct connection even if HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY are set in the environment

type.description: Provider type that determines the API format

api_key.description: API key for authentication with the provider

oauth.description: OAuth2 token for authentication with the provider

account.description: ID of the active account for this provider

rotation.description: Automatic account rotation settings for this provider

system_prompt_prefix.description: Custom prefix to add to system prompts for this provider

extra_headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to send with requests

extra_body.description: Additional fields to include in request bodies, only works with openai-compatible providers

provider_options.description: Additional provider-specific options for this provider

aws_auth_refresh.description: Shell command to run when AWS credentials expire (Bedrock only).

discover_models.description: Auto-discover models from /v1/models endpoint. When true with existing models they are merged (yours win)

models.description: List of models available from this provider

enabled.description: Automatically rotate to another account for this provider

min_remaining_percent.description: Rotate once remaining allowance drops below this percentage (1-99); only valid for providers that report remaining allowance

cooldown.description: How long to treat a rate-limited account as exhausted before retrying it, as a Go duration (e.g. 10m); only valid for providers with no remaining-allowance reporting

order.description: Account IDs in the order rotation should try them; empty means the order they were added in

model.description: The model ID as used by the provider API

provider.description: The model provider ID that matches a key in the providers config

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort level for OpenAI models that support it

think.description: Enable thinking mode for Anthropic models that support reasoning

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens for model responses

presence_penalty.description: Presence penalty to increase topic diversity

provider_options.description: Additional provider-specific options for the model

compact_mode.description: Enable compact mode for the TUI interface

diff_mode.description: Diff mode for the TUI interface

theme.description: Color palette for the TUI, chosen with the /theme command. An unknown value falls back to the default theme

transparent.description: Enable transparent background for the TUI interface

spinner.description: Motion of the working indicator while the agent is busy. scramble is the animated glyph band; pulse keeps the band but moves a single highlight across it; dots is one braille spinner; none leaves only the label and the elapsed timer.

keybindings.description: Keyboard shortcuts keyed by action name. Each value replaces the default shortcuts for that action

worktree_dir.description: Parent directory for thread worktrees (<worktree_dir>/<thread-name>). A relative path resolves against the parent of the repository root; an absolute path is used as-is. Defaults to "threads" inside the workspace data directory (.sennit/threads).

timeout.description: Timeout for the glob tool call
Timeout for the grep tool call

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for the ls tool

max_items.description: Maximum number of items to return for the ls tool

api_key.description: API key for the web search provider (shell-expanded), e.g. $TAVILY_API_KEY. Not used by the duckduckgo provider.

base_url.description: Override the search provider's default API endpoint (self-hosted or proxy-compatible deployments)

proxy_url.description: Proxy URL for web search requests (http/https/socks5); set to "none" to force a direct connection even if HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY are set in the environment
